title: Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program — Replacement, Case and Theft Charge Schedule
content:
Property schedule for district-owned instruments in the Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program. The usage fee does not insure an instrument against loss or theft; these are the charges for an instrument or case that is lost, stolen or not returned.

| Usage type | Charge for an instrument lost or not returned (USD; for a pair, per instrument) | Charge for a lost or destroyed case (USD) | Charge for a stolen instrument when a police report number is given within the report window (USD) | Calendar days after the theft within which the police report number must be given (theft date is day 0) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Percussion Equipment Usage | 375.00 | 45.00 | 50.00 | 5 |
| Woodwind Instrument Usage | 3150.00 | 160.00 | 250.00 | 5 |
| Brass Instrument Usage | 2850.00 | 140.00 | 250.00 | 5 |
| Orchestra String Instrument Usage | 1250.00 | 95.00 | 150.00 | 5 |
| Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass) | 5400.00 | 280.00 | 400.00 | 5 |
| Summer Instrument Checkout | 3150.00 | 160.00 | 250.00 | 5 |

## Points read from the schedule

- **The pair.** Under Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass), where the student holds one instrument for home and one kept at school, the charge for an instrument lost or not returned is 5400.00 per instrument, so both instruments of a pair not returned come to 10800.00.
- **The report window.** The theft report window is 5 calendar days under every usage type, the theft date being day 0: a police report number given on day 5 is inside the window, one given on day 6 is not.
- **The case.** The case charge is a separate line from the instrument charge.

Hypothetical illustration: a viola under Orchestra String Instrument Usage stolen with its case, with a police report number given on day 2 after the theft, falls in the column of 150.00 for the instrument; the case line is 95.00.
